I am 61 and I have worked this land since I was young. I own this plot, so I always put manure on it, and this year I will also buy a small amount of urea from the cooperative — enough for about 20 kilos of nitrogen per hectare, because I am sharing a bag with my neighbor and I will not go into debt. I will plant my own saved barley seed, not the improved kind from the shop, and we will pull weeds by hand because barley does not need chemicals. My daughter and I will do most of the work ourselves, about 25 family days in total, but I will hire two young men for two days at harvest to help with the cutting.
